parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent duplicate submissions. You can generate the value of this parameter on the client side. The value must be unique across different requests and can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters. The value cannot contain non-ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the instance. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the migration task
parameters.name: migrate_task_id

parameters.help_en:
The consistency check method used after the database is opened. Valid values:
SyncExecuteDBCheck: Executes the database check synchronously.
AsyncExecuteDBCheck: Executes the database check asynchronously.

Compatible with SQL Server 2008 R2
parameters.help_zh:
打开数据库后的一致性检查方法，取值：
SyncExecuteDBCheck：同步执行DB检查。
AsyncExecuteDBCheck：异步执行DB检查。

兼容SQL Server 2008 R2版本
parameters.name: check_db_mode

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to retain the database-level and table-level Change Data Capture (CDC) settings and the data in change tables. Regardless of the value of this parameter, CDC jobs are not rebuilt

是否保留库表级别的CDC开关，以及Change Table数据。
不论此参数是何取值，都不会重建CDC jobs
